changes.old: Close shot at a public square after the 1906 fire, an anonymous adult carries a plain blanket toward a canvas tent, dim lamp light
changes.new: Medium shot in a San Francisco public square on the first night after the April 1906 earthquake and fire, one fully grown grey-haired resident with a lined face in a plain early-1900s wool coat carries rolled bedding toward a simple blanket stretched over a pole; a few other mature adults rest on bare ground in the distance, fading daylight

changes.old: Close shot at a refuge after the 1906 fire, an unnamed resident straightens a plain canvas tent, gentle window light
changes.new: Close shot outside a simple canvas tent in a San Francisco public square in summer 1906, one visibly middle-aged resident with grey temples, facial lines and a plain early-1900s wool coat reties a loose tent flap; bare ground and other canvas tents behind, soft overcast daylight

changes.old: Wide shot at a refuge after the 1906 fire, an anonymous adult checks the edge of a canvas shelter, muted afternoon light
changes.new: Wide shot in a San Francisco relief camp in late summer 1906, one visibly middle-aged grey-haired resident with a lined face in a plain early-1900s coat stands at the opening of a simple canvas tent and looks toward gathering clouds; tents rest on bare ground, soft overcast daylight

changes.old: Close shot at a refuge after the 1906 fire, an anonymous builder sets a plain wooden board beside a simple plan, dim lamp light
changes.new: Medium shot in a San Francisco relief camp in summer 1906 before cottage construction, two visibly middle-aged relief workers with grey hair, lined faces and plain early-1900s coats stand among simple canvas tents; one points to separate empty patches of bare ground while the other considers the spacing, soft overcast daylight, only tents and unbuilt ground visible

changes.old: Wide shot at a refuge after the 1906 fire, an anonymous surveyor studies a small blank lot diagram, diffuse morning light
changes.new: Wide shot of the cramped open ground at San Francisco South Park in summer 1906, one visibly middle-aged relief worker with grey temples and a lined face in a plain early-1900s coat stands between nearby canvas tents and gauges the narrow strip of bare ground with outstretched hands, soft overcast daylight

changes.old: Close shot at a refuge after the 1906 fire, an anonymous clerk carries an unmarked folder toward a work table, gentle window light
changes.new: Medium shot at a San Francisco relief camp on August 1, 1906, one visibly middle-aged relief clerk with grey hair and facial lines in a plain early-1900s coat speaks to a small group of fully grown residents beside simple canvas tents, one open hand extended toward the camp grounds, soft overcast daylight

changes.old: Wide shot at a public square in August 1906, an anonymous clerk studies an unmarked land plan beside a plain canvas tent, mild overcast light
changes.new: Wide shot at the edge of a San Francisco public square in August 1906, one visibly middle-aged grey-haired relief worker with a lined face in a plain early-1900s coat walks past canvas tents and looks across the open public ground toward the surrounding street, soft overcast daylight
